stages.title: Expression discipline
stages.body: Track signs, brackets, domains and denominators.

stages.title: Simultaneous equations
stages.body: Use elimination, substitution or option testing.

stages.title: Inequalities
stages.body: Reverse the sign only when multiplying or dividing by a negative.

stages.title: Absolute value and surds
stages.body: Split valid cases and respect non-negative roots.

stages.title: Word translation
stages.body: Define variables and constraints before manipulating.

stages.title: DS format
stages.body: Read the printed verdict options before solving.

stages.title: Necessary and sufficient
stages.body: Test each statement alone, then together.

stages.title: Counterexample search
stages.body: One second valid value disproves uniqueness.

stages.title: Verification
stages.body: Substitute, test domains and separate answer value from sufficiency.
